cohort: 36,086 women with singleton term pregnancies giving live births in Sweden between 2009 and 2013
finding: Neonatal hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy was associated with acute obstetrical events, mode of delivery other than unassisted vaginal birth, abnormal CTG admission test, and nulliparity.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery other than unassisted vaginal birth was associated with an increased risk of neonatal hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy.
